service_error_contract: Each service is the complete declared bounded source/inverse, memory, record or next-address controller map, with its full Stinespring operator-norm error bounded by delta. This is not an elementary hardware gate count. The initial trace-norm error is one bound on the FULL JOINT input, not inferred from separate marginals. The hybrid bound includes admission, calibration, every failed prefix and one chosen readout. The exact rational-phase circuit is the nominal reference. These perturbation hypotheses are separate from its certified arithmetic.
finite_implementation: Exact rational matching phases, all inactive weights and conditioning retained; outward arithmetic encloses actual circuit.
pair_scope: Full independent product instrument on separately admitted signed sources, bound by the fresh global-column join.
